title: Adding a recipe of nether portal
description: This mod adds the recipe of nether portal.
body:
This mod adds the recipe of nether portal.

- You can make nether portals to put 'fire charge' or 'flint and steel' in the center and put 8 obsidians around the fire charge or flint and steel in craft tables.
- You can make nether ingots to smelt nether portals.
- You can make nether pickaxe to put 3 nether ingots at the top and put 2 sticks in center line in craft tables.



- If you put nether portals and touch them, you can go the nether.
- If you make nether pickaxe and break nether portals with it, the nether portals will break, and then you can get nether portals.
- Nether pickaxe has abilities as much as iron pickaxe.
